## What

Cut the user-visible message strings over: `src/rebar/_commands/txn.py:556,597,600,614` (and the
docstrings at 532,564,568) and `src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py:34,58`
(`COMPLETION_REMEDIATION_GUIDANCE`, `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_REMEDIATION`).

## Note on INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_REMEDIATION

Its text draws the distinction that motivated this tag name: record code proof as an UNTAGGED
comment; do NOT tag code-verifiable criteria. Re-word it against `[non-codebase]` and the
instruction becomes self-reinforcing rather than merely prohibitive — a test path is obviously
not "non-codebase".

## Asserting tests to update

`tests/unit/test_attested_close_guard.py:55`,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ac_checkbox_precheck.py:80`,
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ac_checkbox_precheck_heldout.py:235`,
`tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py:178`,
`tests/unit/workflow/test_insufficient_evidence_marker.py:341-342` (asserts the exact
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_REMEDIATION phrases this story rewords — "do not tag code-verifiable" and
"reserved for evidence that inherently lives outside"),
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_attested_close_guard_e2e.py` (the EXISTING end-to-end cover for
the laundering and provenance guards; its docstring and its fixtures at lines 65/79/95/110 seed
`[operator-attested]`, so AC3's end-to-end proof extends this file rather than adding a new one).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The four asserting tests are updated and pass.
